name: Benchmark of batch-effect correction methods for single-cell RNA sequencing data
description: Evaluation suite comparing batch-effect correction methods on single-cell RNA-seq datasets to measure integration quality and preservation of biological signal.
reputation: Commonly cited in single-cell genomics to compare batch-correction methods and guide method selection in the community.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; results are sensitive to dataset composition and choice of metrics. There is an inherent trade-off between removing batch effects and preserving true biological variation.
